title: Neon Spire V4 views (software rendering, quality high)

views.label: skyline from the start
views.js: () => { const g = __game, t = g.scene.race.track, N = t.N, P = (i, x, y) => { const v = t.pointAt(t.wrapIdx(Math.round(i)), x, y); return [v.x, v.y, v.z]; };return { pos: P(-30, 0, 6), at: P(70, 0, 70), fov: 72 }; }

views.label: close pass between towers
views.js: () => { const g = __game, t = g.scene.race.track, N = t.N, P = (i, x, y) => { const v = t.pointAt(t.wrapIdx(Math.round(i)), x, y); return [v.x, v.y, v.z]; };return { pos: P(N * 0.62, 22, -10), at: P(N * 0.62 + 30, 10, -25), fov: 70 }; }

views.label: toward the low sun (glare check)
views.js: () => { const g = __game, t = g.scene.race.track, N = t.N, P = (i, x, y) => { const v = t.pointAt(t.wrapIdx(Math.round(i)), x, y); return [v.x, v.y, v.z]; };const p = P(N * 0.25, 0, 60), s = g.scene.course.env.sunDir; return { pos: p, at: [p[0] + s.x * 1000, p[1] + 60, p[2] + s.z * 1000], fov: 70 }; }
